root-count.summary: nested classification must select exactly one top composite containsBlock root

contains-cycle.summary: the nested composite containsBlock graph must be acyclic

replaceable.summary: replaceable CXF components must be resolved before import

banned-modelica-key.summary: banned Modelica construct keys must not survive CXF lowering

array-parameter.summary: array-valued composite parameters are outside the CXF lowering subset

array-connector.summary: active array-valued connector nodes require per-element encoding

array-instance.summary: active array-valued block-instance nodes require per-element encoding

declaration-cycle.summary: a block's own parameter/constant declaration references must be acyclic

duplicate-declaration.summary: a block's own declaration chain must not bind one local name twice

vector-port-instance.summary: a hasInstance-derived instance's class must publish declared scalar port names

unsupported-instance-member.summary: a hasInstance member must be a direct member naming a declared port or parameter of its instance's class

colliding-member-identity.summary: a derived connector or parameter identity must be unique in its document and within its instance
